data.narrative:
Epirus is a Series D-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $550M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms—including same-stage Defense & Security peers Helsing, Saronic, Chaos Industries, and Onebrief.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression anchors to the last post-money valuation of $1.4B and applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D advancement, yielding $2.0B. Peer-Median triangulation across 4 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $6.9B, with the underlying peer set ranging from $2.1B (Onebrief) to $18.0B (Helsing). The dispersion reflects meaningful variation in investor positioning and stage interpretation within the Defense & Security frontier-tech cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.7B (low) to $7.9B (high), with a median of $4.5B. The wide range reflects two key uncertainties: first, substantive disagreement among stage-progression and peer-median methods regarding appropriate valuation multiples; second, the heterogeneity of the peer set itself, where Helsing's $18B valuation sits well above the median, suggesting potential outlier dynamics or differentiated market positioning. Revenue scale, customer concentration, and defensibility of technical moat would narrow this band materially.
